County Government
County Government
The County Government pages are designed to keep you informed about Muskegon County Government. You will find a Board of Commissioners site which includes board agendas and minutes . A Courts page provides a link to District Court , Circuit Court and Probate Court websites and also includes phone numbers. The Elected Offices Page contains links to the offices of the seven County elected officials.
The County Departments page includes a link to the department's website and contact information. The Building Locations link can help you find your way to the various County Building locations.
